facts.fact: TNM says it acquired additional fibre routes into Malawi via Zambia (Mchinji/Chipata, from ZESCO/Telecom Namibia and MTN Zambia) and Mozambique (Muloza/Mulanje, from TMCel) after subsea cable cuts left it only the Mchinji/Chipata link.

systems.owner: TNM Plc with ZESCO, MTN Zambia, TMCel
